### 2026-10-27: I just had an amazing idea

**0.5h**

I just had an amazing idea

This morning I was trying to figure out how to budget everything in. Along with that how it would be done. Then I randomly thought, could i measure the tempature of the window to calculate the outdoor temp? Turns out you can, this simplifies the use of the tempature sensor greatly. I can't wait to get to work on the project this afternoon.

Thanks for reading!

### 2026-10-27: Alot of work happened today and im very lazy now

**4.3h**

Alot of work happened today and im very lazy now

First of all I worked a little bit more to make sure i had the best components that would work for the idea. Then I started/finished work on the schematic, It was relatively easy thanks to going to 1M different websites for everything and some gemini (dont slime me).

After I was done with that I worked on the board, halfway through I got 3D models for most of the components. Im still very obsessed with my star design  lol, so I had to include it. Feel free to gaze upon it in the photos.

I might have done more but im so tired that I dont remember. Yeah ik nobody will see the star design as I will design a 3d printed case for this but whatever. Yeah next days plan is starting that 3D model. After that comes the first layer of hell, the code.
